purpose: Independent historical training reproduction, separate from prospectively confirming V3. This plan does not reopen NO-GO.
cohort_notes: A10080GB original. A different GPU/software must define a separate reproduction cohort, not falsify an exact historical resume. CUDA/driver/backend may preclude bitwise identical training.
budget_limits: Sum of nominal immutable120s opportunities, not actual GPU hours or end-to-end runtime. Original wall-clock stopping means matched software/GPU does not guarantee identical epoch counts; downtime and I/O cannot be converted to GPU consumption.
prior_tolerances_apply_to: A aggregate tables from frozen predictions
training_tolerance_policy: C-specific tolerance and scope must be declared by the external person before execution. A=1e-14+1e-12 and B=1e-6 do not justify accepting arbitrary training differences. No C tolerance has been invented.
inputs_before_C: Verified source snapshot and all job-level requests, selection manifests, data, RNG/optimizer states and runtime locks
External person identity and declared relationship; date/time; selected historical scope; explicit resource budget
New isolated reproduction ID and output root; original snapshot mounted/read only
Prespecified C comparison products, tolerances and expected hardware dependence
Training driver reviewed to use new IDs and no writes to originals; original notebook resume commands are not safe fresh-run commands
missing_driver_reason: A safe new historical-reproduction campaign driver is not supplied by the accepted ONNX replay; using a resume cell would risk modifying the original campaign. Human A/B commands are executable now; C remains separately planned.
